item.title: FDA Takes Steps to Maintain Newborn Access to Life-Saving Starter Nutrition Products
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today announced it is taking action, consistent with the Trump administration’s commitment to protecting vulnerable patients and maintaining access to critical medical products, to help address a potential supply gap of neonatal starter parenteral nutrition (PN)
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Grants Accelerated Approval to a New Breast Cancer Treatment
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today expanded treatment options for adult patients with advanced breast cancer, reflecting the FDA’s commitment to advancing medical innovation and getting new treatments to patients who need them.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Approves First Drug to Treat Alexander Disease
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved Zanvastro (zilganersen) injection for the treatment of Alexander disease in pediatric and adult patients.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Issues Emergency Use Authorization for Drugs to Prevent and Treat New World Screwworm in Dogs and Cats
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today issued an Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) for Capstar (nitenpyram) tablets and revised the EUA for Nitenpyram Tablets, the generic version of Capstar
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Seeks Public Input to Advance Development of Botanical Drug Products
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today announced a request for information (RFI) to gather public input on opportunities to advance the development of botanical drug products.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Approves First Drug of Its Kind for Polycythemia Vera, a Rare Blood Disorder
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved Mimrylo (rusfertide), a new treatment for adults with polycythemia vera, a rare blood disorder that causes the body to make too many red blood cells.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Approves First Oral Drug Indicated to Treat Dermatomyositis in Adults
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved Lisraya (brepocitinib) tablets for the treatment of dermatomyositis in adults.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Issues Emergency Use Authorization for Generic Drug to Prevent New World Screwworm in Cattle
item.description: FDA issues Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) for Bimectin (ivermectin) injection for the prevention of New World screwworm (NWS) infestations (myiasis) in cattle when administered within 24 hours of birth, at the time of castration, or at the appearance of a wound.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Approves First in Class Targeted Therapy for Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved Rasonque (daraxonrasib), a RAS inhibitor for the most common form of pancreatic cancer—delivering a new treatment option to patients with advanced pancreatic cancer months ahead of schedule.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Authorizes First Wearable Device That Continuously Monitors Both Ketone Levels and Blood Sugar
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today authorized the Libre Duo 10 Day Continuous Dual Glucose Ketone Monitoring System for people aged 2 years and older living with diabetes.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Approves First Therapy for Patients aged 8 years and older with Glycogen Storage Disease Type Ia
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today issued an accelerated approval for Genglycos (pariglasgene brecaparvovec-opnr) as the first-ever treatment for adults and children 8 years of age and older with glycogen storage disease type Ia (GSDIa)
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Authorizes First-Of-Its-Kind Robotic Blood Draw Device
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today authorized the Aletta, the first standalone robotic device that can draw blood from a patient’s arm without hands-on operator intervention.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Seeks Public Feedback to Inform Regulatory Approach for Generative AI-Enabled Medical Devices
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today issued a discussion paper on considerations for the regulation of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI)-enabled medical devices, seeking feedback from interested parties on risk assessment, premarket evaluation, postmarket monitoring, and other topics
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Issues Emergency Use Authorization for Drug to Treat New World Screwworm in Dogs and Puppies
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today issued an Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) for Simparica TRIO (sarolaner, moxidectin, and pyrantel chewable tablets) for the treatment of New World screwworm (NWS) infestations (myiasis) in dogs and puppies.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Issues Emergency Use Authorization for Drug to Prevent New World Screwworm in Multiple Species, Including Sheep, Cattle, Goats, and Swine
item.description: FDA today issued an Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) for CLiK Extra (dicyclanil topical suspension) wound spray for application on or around wounds for the prevention of New World screwworm (NWS) infestations (myiasis).
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Approves New Engineered Viral Immunotherapy for Patients with Treatment-Resistant Advanced Melanoma
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today granted accelerated approval to Tudriqev (vusolimogene oderparepvec-wtpg), a genetically modified oncolytic viral therapy for the treatment of advanced, refractory melanoma.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Approves First Drug to Treat the Full Range of Narcolepsy Type 1 Symptoms
item.description: The FDA approved Orzeyful (oveporexton) tablets for the treatment of narcolepsy type 1 in adults.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Licenses First-Ever Freeze-Dried Plasma Product in the U.S.
item.description: FDA today licensed Ezplaz Freeze Dried Plasma (FDP), making it the first freeze-dried plasma product licensed for use in the United States. Ezplaz is intended for transfusion in adult patients who need plasma and for whom other plasma products are not available.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Announces First Participant Selected for TEMPO for Digital Health Devices Pilot
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today announced the first manufacturer selected for the Technology-Enabled Meaningful Patient Outcomes (TEMPO) for Digital Health Devices Pilot.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Takes Further Steps to Remove Outdated Authorizations for Color Additives in Food
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today announced two actions targeting petroleum-based color additives in food, continuing the agency’s broader efforts to Make America Healthy Again.
item.dc:creator: FDA
